schema.order: Manual display order for the directory. Lower numbers appear first in the default sort.
schema.slug: Manufacturer slug. This should match the manufacturer profile URL slug.
schema.profile_completeness_percent: 0-100 percentage. Higher means the profile has more useful buyer-facing information.
schema.response_time_tier: Response speed tier. One of: within_24h, within_3_days, within_1_week, unknown.
schema.published_article_count: Count only. Number of articles published in Industry News for this manufacturer. This is not a score.
